en.name: Chicken broth, stock or consommé (commercial)
en.summary: Commercially produced chicken broth, stock and consommé come as cans, cartons, concentrates and cubes, and for an unopened pack the answer is a rule rather than a number: go by the use-by date printed on the package. Refrigerated, broth runs about 7 days, or 3–4 days once the pack has been opened. Frozen, it holds about 2–3 months.
en.pantry: There is no fixed cupboard timeline for an unopened can or carton — the package use-by date is the guide, with the pack kept cool, dry and out of the sun. Once it is opened, the pantry stops being an option: broth is a low-acid, protein-rich liquid that spoils quickly at room temperature. Refrigerate it within two hours, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F), and never leave a pan of it on the stove to cool overnight.
en.fridge: Keep chicken broth at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a sealed container rather than in the opened can. Fresh or prepared refrigerated broth runs about 7 days; an opened shelf-stable carton or can is about 3–4 days. Cool it quickly before it goes in — a shallow container, or the pan sat in a sink of iced water, clears the 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) danger zone far faster than a deep pot will. Reheat only what you need, and bring it to a full rolling boil.
en.freezer: Chicken broth freezes well. Pour it into rigid containers or flat-laid bags at −18 °C (0 °F), leaving headspace for expansion, where it holds about 2–3 months of good quality. Frozen food kept at that temperature stays safe indefinitely, so the timeline is a flavour one. Freeze some as cubes for the splash a pan sauce needs, and the rest in the portion size you actually cook with.
en.thawing: Thaw chicken broth in the fridge, or drop the frozen block straight into a hot pan. Never thaw it on the counter, and bring thawed broth to a rolling boil before use.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly dented can — discard it without opening
Cloudiness, ropy strands or sliminess in what should be a clear liquid
A sour, fermented or otherwise off smell
Fizzing or bubbles in a sealed container
tips: Decant an opened can into a glass or plastic container immediately.
Label frozen portions with the date and the quantity.
Cool broth fast in a shallow dish, not slowly in a deep pot.
Keep bouillon cubes or concentrate as the long-life standby; the reconstituted broth lasts 3-4 days in the refrigerator.

faq.q: How long does opened chicken broth last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–4 days once the carton or can is opened, sealed and kept at 4 °C or below. Fresh refrigerated broth runs about 7 days.
Yes. Portion it with headspace and freeze at −18 °C for about 2–3 months of good quality.

faq.q: How long does an unopened carton of chicken broth keep?
faq.a: There is no fixed timeline — follow the use-by date printed on the package, stored cool and dry.

faq.q: Can you keep broth in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Move it to a sealed glass or plastic container; once air reaches the can the broth takes on a metallic taste.

zh.name: 市售雞高湯
zh.summary: 市售雞高湯有罐裝、利樂包、濃縮液和高湯塊等形式，未開封的答案是一條規則而不是數字：以包裝上的有效日期為準。冷藏方面，高湯大約 7 天，開封後 3～4 天。冷凍大約 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭或紙盒沒有固定的櫥櫃天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥、避免日曬的地方。一旦開封，櫥櫃就不再是選項：高湯是低酸、富含蛋白質的液體，在室溫下很快變質。請在兩小時內冷藏，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時，也絕對不要把整鍋留在爐上放涼過夜。
zh.fridge: 請放 4 °C 以下，裝在密封容器裡而不是開過的罐頭中。市售冷藏或現成高湯大約 7 天；常溫包裝開封後大約 3～4 天。放進冰箱前先快速降溫——用淺容器分裝，或把鍋子坐在裝冰水的水槽裡，都比整鍋慢慢放涼更快通過 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶。每次只加熱要用的份量，而且要煮到大滾。
zh.freezer: 雞高湯很適合冷凍。留出膨脹空間裝進硬質容器或平放的密封袋，放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，所以這是風味期限。可以凍一部分成冰塊，做鍋底醬時很方便，其餘按實際下廚會用到的份量分裝。
zh.thawing: 雞高湯請放冷藏解凍，或直接把凍塊丟進熱鍋。絕對不要放室溫解凍，解凍後使用前要煮到大滾。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重凹陷——不要開，直接丟掉
本該清澈的湯變濁、出現絲狀物或黏稠感
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或其他異味
密封容器裡冒氣或有氣泡
tips: 開罐後立刻移到玻璃或塑膠容器。
冷凍分裝要標日期和份量。
用淺盤快速降溫，不要用深鍋慢慢放涼。
常備高湯塊或濃縮高湯當長效備品；泡開後的高湯在冰箱可以放 3-4 天。

faq.q: 開封的雞高湯放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 紙盒或罐頭開封後，密封放 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 天。市售冷藏高湯則大約 7 天。
可以。留膨脹空間分裝後放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的雞高湯可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有固定天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥處。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到密封的玻璃或塑膠容器；空氣接觸罐身後，高湯會帶金屬味。
